name: Deep Mud
disable: DC 15 Survival check to navigate a safe path along the remaining bits of stone

items.name: Squelch
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps in the mud

---

Effect Deep mud sucks at the creature's feet. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 16 basic Reflex save save as they pull against the mud and struggle to stay upright. On a failure, the mud deals 2d4 bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone.

text: The mud greedily latches onto anything that lands in it, hampering movement.
